method: TCP aggregate delivered payload goodput, 10s rounds / 2s discarded warmup, victim 10.55.0.100, sequential domains, UL/DL separate
scope: Achievable end-to-end goodput with these VM generators, not physical link capacity
mitigation: Temporarily suspended using LAB_CALIBRATION_MODE, forwarding and telemetry retained; finally restoration plus 15 minute watchdog
enterprise_forwarding: Temporary TCP calibration-only rules between Enterprise 10.70.0.0/24 and victim 10.55.0.100 on br-ent, in_port 3 <-> 5, priority 20 below mitigation priority 100, cookie 0xbe910090, 900s expiry; removed at cleanup
selection: Minimum of directional medians; three initial repeats per direction, optional two additional repeats when initial max/min exceeds 1.3. Scalar reference accommodates BENIGN_V1 bidirectional traffic conservatively.

mobile_actuation_check.evidence: RIC /status snapshot taken during final Mobile calibration

limitations: TCP payload goodput with these Python generators; not physical link capacity or UDP loss capacity.
Domains measured separately; references do not guarantee simultaneous peaks.
Enterprise used calibration-only data-plane forwarding rules.
Any TCP reset is reported; its partial received bytes are divided by the full 8s measurement window, including the outage.
Observed variability and VM scheduling are retained in the directional ranges.
